objective: Determine whether arbitrary positive middle wiring with only pairwise identifications in both roles can express general strict 3-SAT. Count middle placements and padding placements separately, with arbitrary supplied wiring and actual private raw switch guards.
status: Proved: NP-completeness survives simultaneous bounds of two middle occurrences and two edge-pad placements per name, including in a uniform fixed-wiring family. Conditioning the q pads required in both polarities gives an O(2^q r) solver on arbitrary middle wiring.
title: Does using every middle name and every padding name at most twice suffice for an efficient regrouping?
